messages.author: ddfb5759b917dfb6
messages.subject: Release for commercial purpose
parts:
Hello,

Months ago, I saw in your website that you would release a commercial version of shiny, including secure connection, login/password, etc. I inscribed me in a mailing list... never received anything.

By the way I think I remembered it was first planned for June 2013... Is it possible to get any news about this ? We are really interested in such release of Shiny to develop end-user GUI for our customers, to use easily the power of R.

We would be also interested in the pricing. We are of course ready in helping for bugs tracking, even in early version of such commercial release.

Thanks in advance.

Pierre

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Release for commercial purpose
parts:
Sorry for the long delay. We are working on the commercial version of Shiny Server as our top priority and are making excellent progress, but we have nothing public to say about release dates at this time.

Pricing is not finalized yet but please e-mail Tareef Kawaf (tar...@rstudio.com) and he can send you our current thinking on how it might look, and he might be able to share estimated timelines as well. Thanks for your interest.
